source: AWS Price List API (pricing:GetProducts), us-east-1, OnDemand terms. Service codes: AmazonBedrockFoundationModels (Anthropic models), AmazonBedrock (Amazon and OpenAI models).
notes: Claude models are invoked through us. geographic inference profiles. They are priced at the Regional on-demand rate (usage type USE1-MP:USE1_*TokenCount-Units), not the lower Global rate, which applies to global. profiles.
Prompt-cache, batch, provisioned and latency-optimized prices are excluded; this harness uses none of them.
